findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resolve_birth_time, aspects, doshas · Public sink: resolve_birth_time, planet_positions, aspects, natal_chart, transits, synastry, nakshatras, panchang, kundli, kundli_full, vimshottari_dasha, doshas, gun_milan, vedic_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resolve_birth_time, aspects, doshas · Public sink: resolve_birth_time, planet_positions, aspects, natal_chart, transits, synastry, nakshatras, panchang, kundli, kundli_full, vimshottari_dasha, doshas, gun_milan, vedic_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
